content.text: Prompt identification and discontinuation of the causative and sus drug(s) (taken w.in 6 wks b4 onset) = critical
Stop culprit and cross-reactive drugs; ⍉empiric abx, analgesics or any other drugs as much as poss in the acute and subacut phases

meta.title: Stop the culprit drug; ⍉nonessential drugs
